Indigo Delight

Indigo Delight is a female-fronted outfit specialising in urban vibes with plenty of RnB, Hip-Hop, Pop, and Soul in their repertoire.

About Indigo Delight

Indigo Delight is a silky-smooth RnB, soul, hip-hop, and pop band with a vibrant sound and serious stagecraft. Available as a 4 or 5-piece lineup , their signature style blends modern favourites with golden-era grooves, filling dancefloors at weddings and events since 2017 . The band is fronted by the outstanding Shamyra , whose rich, effortless tone draws comparisons to Sade, Lauryn Hill , and Whitney Houston . She’s performed across the UK, toured internationally, featured in NME and BBC Radio , and trained at the British Institute of Modern Music . Shamyra is backed by a stellar rhythm section and full-time pros: bass, keys, guitar, drums , and backing vocals throughout. The band’s collective credits include Jamie Cullum, Coree Richards , Radio 1 Big Weekend , the West End , and more—meaning you’re guaranteed a polished, professional performance every time. With a 400+ song repertoire , a dedicated band manager , and a warm, flexible approach, Indigo Delight offers seamless service and unforgettable sound from first note to final encore.
